cases.spec_ref: The data→AGS4 door (`build_ags4`) across all four surfaces. Each has its OWN input idiom — a polars frame (python), row-objects (node `buildAgs4`), a JSON string (wasm `build_ags4`), a `GroupInput` (rust-leaf) — but all route through the ONE shared emit orchestrator, so the built bytes (with the dictionary-filled UNIT/TYPE and the AutoFix-added TRAN/UNIT/TYPE groups) must be byte-identical. A surface re-implementing build would diverge from the leaf.

AGS4 numeric rendering is the ENGINE's job, from the declared TYPE: `laterite-ags4-types::ags4_str` formats a JSON number per its type (2DP `LOCA_NATE`: 12.3 -> `12.30`, 100.456 -> `100.46`), and every surface routes through it. A surface that stringified numbers itself — the obvious thing for a host binding to do — would emit `12.3` here and split from the leaf. NOTE: this case deliberately carries no INTEGER-valued cell. Adding one splits the node leg, which renders a whole JS number as `5.0` where rust/python/wasm render `5` (every JS number is an f64); that divergence is real and unresolved, so pin it in its own case once ruled on rather than smuggling it in here.

AGS4 Rule-1 field escaping (a literal `"` doubled to `""`, a comma kept inside the quoted field) has ONE authority — `laterite-ags4-types::write_quoted_field` — which the byte writer streams through and the browser tokenizer reuses. A surface re-implementing quoting would corrupt exactly this value.

A null cell is an EMPTY AGS4 field, not the string `null`/`None`/`NaN`. Each surface carries its own null idiom (polars null, JS null, JSON null, serde `Value::Null`) and they must all land on `""` via `ags4_str`'s null branch — the classic place a host binding leaks its own representation into the bytes.

A three-group build with a parent/child chain (PROJ -> LOCA -> SAMP): group ORDER is preserved as given, each group's UNIT/TYPE rows are filled from the dictionary, and the shared KEY heading `LOCA_ID` appears in both parent and child. Pins that no surface reorders groups or fills metadata differently.

The SYNTHESIS path of the build door, which every earlier build case leaves off. Synthesis mints whole GROUPS the caller never wrote (UNIT/TYPE from the data, ABBR for PA codes) and stamps the caller's TRAN, so a surface that diverges here produces a file with different groups, not merely different bytes - and nothing else compares that across surfaces. It also pins the five TRAN values landing in their own headings on all four legs at once: they are same-typed and adjacent in every surface's internal call, so a transposition is invisible to every compiler involved.

The judge-free build door (#858/#882/#883) on its clean path: `build_ags4_unchecked` / `buildAgs4Unchecked` must produce the byte-identical file the judged Report build produces — same dictionary UNIT/TYPE fills, same canonical cell formatting, same section order — on every surface. The verdict is what is absent, not the assembly.

The door's defining value question: a STRING `"1.0"` under the 2DP heading LOCA_GL is data the judged AutoFix door rewrites to `"1.00"` — unchecked must keep it VERBATIM, identically on every surface. A surface that quietly judged (or quietly reformatted) diverges here and nowhere on the clean case.
